data.summary: Senior Business Analyst with 4+ years in requirements and Agile delivery, built on 8+ years in financial operations. Skilled in eliciting and documenting business and data rules (pricing, reference data, corporate actions, regulatory reporting EMIR), mapping field-level specifications and data lineage, defining acceptance criteria, and maintaining traceability through UAT to release—reducing manual effort and operational risk.

all_skills: ISO 20022 and SSI SWIFT data (MT541, MT543)

responsibilities: Led the end-to-end business analysis for the EMIR Refit implementation for the Exchange-Traded Derivatives (ETD) asset class, performing gap analysis against newly released DTCC technical specifications.
Translated complex
functional specifications, structured user stories, and measurable Acceptance Criteria to map data lineage for engineering teams.
regulatory updates
into detailed
field-level

Conducted technical walkthroughs of the new reporting logic for Compliance and Business teams to secure formal signoffs, and guided developers throughout Agile sprints to ensure compliance with DTCC specs.
Partnered with the QA team to review and refine field-level test cases for robust validation, while maintaining dedicated Confluence frameworks to track project progress and document business rules.
Drove BA scope for the pricing platform transformation with the Product Owner,
delivering high-integrity data feeds to downstream Fund accounting systems.
Designed validation rules and control mechanisms to strengthen data governance and
reduce operational risk across pricing workflows.
Participated in UAT/NRT: prepared datasets, executed test cases against ACs, and
documented defects with full traceability to user stories.
Validated system enhancements by executing SQL queries for data extraction and
validation to ensure functional integrity of financial data.
Automated pricing feeds from market data vendors, reducing manual efforts by 25%.
Owned
the
functional
integrity of reference data and SSI setups, driving
straight-through processing (STP) and directly reducing trade fails.
Reconciled accrued interest for fixed-income instruments in the static data system
setup to prevent settlement/NAV impacts.
Resolved data mismatches and managed static data changes for corporate actions in
collaboration with external vendors.
Served as the primary functional liaison between the Chennai delivery centre and global business hubs and trained junior analysts.
Managed the pricing of instruments impacted by different corporate action events,
ensuring accurate valuation for downstream fund accounting platforms.
Automated pricing workflows and functioned as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for
team transitions between Hub locations.
Reduced manual errors by 30% and improved turnaround time for pricing updates through enhanced operational efficiency.

raw_sections.summary:
SUMMARY
Senior Business Analyst with 4+ years in requirements and Agile delivery, built on 8+ years in financial operations. Skilled in eliciting and documenting business and data rules (pricing, reference data, corporate actions, regulatory reporting EMIR), mapping field-level specifications and data lineage, defining acceptance criteria, and maintaining traceability through UAT to release—reducing manual effort and operational risk.
raw_sections.skills:
SKILLS
Business Analysis: Requirements Gathering, Business Requirements Document
(BRD), User Stories, Business Logic Analysis, Gap and Root Cause Analysis.
Methodology: Agile Methodology (Scrum) & Backlog Prioritization. • Domain Expertise: Trade Lifecycle, Reference Data Management, Pricing, Corporate actions, regulatory reporting (EMIR), Data Reconciliation and working knowledge of clearing, custody and settlement processes.
Technical & Data Tools: SQL (Data validation & extraction), Excel (advanced), JIRA,
SharePoint, Confluence, HP ALM, Bloomberg and Refinitiv (Reuters).
Standards: ISO 20022 and SSI SWIFT data (MT541, MT543).
